title: Axiom Gate Manifest
description: Build-time discovery manifest for Axiom quality gates. Each entry defines one gate's metadata for compile-time scanning.

gates.description: Sorted list of all registered gates (by id ascending).

layer.description: Architecture layer: meta (L1, no process spawning) or functional (L2, may spawn processes).

entry.description: Path to the gate runner binary or source, relative to project root.

stages.description: Execution stages at which this gate's verdict is wired to fire. Semantics (Orphan Gate Authority Closure, 2026-10-08): 'pre-commit' / 'pre-push' = invoked directly by the corresponding .githooks hook (machine-verified by manifest-consistency-gate Check 10); 'ci' = dispatched by an active AXIOM_CI=1 gate_hook production lane (none exists since ci.yml retirement fa069d610 — no gate may declare 'ci' until such a lane is restored); 'manual' = standalone direct-run contract via the documented runner interface (standalone binary, legacy manifest-driven dispatch, in-process case, or Makefile/NORMATIVE doc invocation), not dispatched by any automated stage. Declared stages MUST have call-site evidence; hook call-sites MUST be declared. minItems 1: a gate scheduled nowhere and invoked by no documented contract must be removed from the manifest (DEBT#425 precedent), not declared with an empty array.

filesPattern.description: Regex or pipe-delimited pattern for matching changed files that trigger this gate. Empty string means always trigger.

passFilenames.description: If true, matched filenames are passed as arguments to the gate runner.

priority.description: Execution priority (higher = earlier within same id). Default 0.

weight.description: Resource cost classification: light (<100MB, <1s), medium (single-process), heavy (full test suite / multi-process).

always_run.description: If true, gate runs even when change-set is empty (opt-in).

tier.description: Execution tier for DAG orchestration: 1 = fast-path (light gates), 2 = deep-path (heavy/compilation gates). Default 1.

hermeticity.description: Cache policy determinism: hermetic (result depends only on declared inputs) or transient (depends on external mutable state). Default hermetic.

after.description: DAG dependency: gate IDs that must complete before this gate runs. Default [].

depsDirs.description: Dependency directories for Merkle fallback memoization when entry is empty.

envVars.description: Environment variables to set before running this gate.

envDependencies.description: External state dependencies for context-aware cache keys.

key.description: Configuration key or environment variable name.

execution_mode.description: Execution policy: aot (pre-compiled binary) or interpreted (nim e at runtime).

category.description: Taxonomy classification for gate governance. Default rule.

description.description: Human-readable description of the gate's purpose.

checks.description: Structured check definitions (used by auto-heal and similar gates).

timeout_seconds.description: Per-gate or per-check timeout in seconds.
